invariants: this unit selects an engineering frontend architecture and does not implement the Event Search UI
the decision must not choose or imply a final query dialect, search index, storage engine or provider
OPEN-013 remains unresolved and Case-link behavior is not implemented or silently defaulted
the selected architecture must preserve backend-neutral Event Search contracts
no third-party product-runtime dependency is accepted without explicit source-backed review and decision evidence
CMDR-owned visual components and design behavior remain first-party even if build-time development tooling is used
security_properties: Class C current external research and adversarial falsification are mandatory
source code, telemetry and user data must not be sent to external services by the frontend runtime
XSS, DOM injection, CSP and Trusted Types compatibility must be evaluated explicitly
dependency and supply-chain surface must be minimized and measured
server-side authorization remains authoritative; frontend checks are never security boundaries

migration.rationale: engineering decision/evidence only; no product runtime or persistent state is changed

rollback.strategy: revert the decision/evidence records and leave Event Search UI implementation unopened
verification: bounded Event Search core remains VERIFIED
no frontend runtime boundary or dependency has been introduced

title: Research and select Event Search frontend runtime architecture
goal: Run a Class C evidence-backed technical decision for the backend-neutral Event Search frontend runtime before any UI implementation, comparing viable first-party/minimal-runtime architectures against framework alternatives under security, accessibility, performance, state/deep-link and supply-chain constraints.
inputs: VERIFIED bounded Event Search core and handoff
CMDR design-system ownership and no-heavy-external-runtime constraint
E5 research and technical decision engine
outputs: Class C engineering decision record for Event Search frontend runtime architecture
saturated current research packet covering all major solution families
candidate trade-off validation with explicit security/accessibility/performance/supply-chain evidence
representative benchmark or prototype evidence if required by the decision gate
adversarial review with no unresolved blocking finding before acceptance
freshness/revisit conditions suitable for later UI implementation
acceptance_tests: decision registry audit accepts the decision lifecycle state
research packet audit proves authoritative current evidence and saturation
decision gate audit proves at least two candidates and Class C adversarial review before acceptance
any performance-sensitive acceptance includes a representative CMDR benchmark
no Product Spec or product-runtime path is modified
the accepted decision does not silently resolve OPEN-013 or backend query/index/storage choices

performance_budget.rationale: frontend architecture is performance-sensitive because Event Search must remain responsive over large result sets and frequent state updates
metrics: representative initial render or state-update benchmark compares the preferred candidate with at least one alternative
bundle/runtime overhead is recorded for candidates where applicable
benchmark environment and workload are explicit and reproducible

definition_of_ready: Event Search bounded core limitations and UI residual are explicit
no accepted frontend architecture decision already exists
definition_of_done: one Class C engineering-only frontend architecture decision is accepted
all declared major solution families have current source-backed evidence
representative performance evidence exists because the decision is performance-sensitive
the preferred candidate survives adversarial review with no blocking finding
no Event Search UI implementation is performed in this task
